title: Ingestion lanes
description: How the bounded ingestion lanes in core are coping: how much work is waiting, what is turned away, and what agents are told to resend. Metrics are published once a minute on JetStream and kept in timeseries_metrics.

panels.title: Queued results by lane
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_name:ingestion_lane_depth time:last_24h bucket:5m agg:max series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Results waiting in each ingestion lane, sampled once a minute. A lane that stays near its capacity is falling behind; compare with its rejections below.

panels.title: Rejected results by lane
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_name:ingestion_lane_rejected time:last_24h bucket:15m agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Results a lane turned away because it was full. Results from an agent that retries (retained plugin results) are sent again; other rejected results are lost.

panels.title: Negative acknowledgements by lane
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_name:ingestion_lane_nacked time:last_24h bucket:15m agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Gateway calls answered with a failure (rejected, timed out, or crashed) by the acknowledging lanes. The agent keeps and resends what was not acknowledged.

panels.title: Rejections by reason
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_name:ingestion_lane_rejected time:last_24h stats:"sum(value) as rejected by tags.reason" sort:rejected:desc limit:20

display_config.caption: Which bound turned results away: total items, total bytes, or one agent's share.

panels.title: Incomplete sync runs
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_name:ingestion_lane_incomplete_runs time:last_24h bucket:1h agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Sync runs that finished with chunks missing. Their devices were ingested but the run was recorded as failed and its snapshot was not activated.
